status: Withdrawn from the active plan: adds product features beyond the user-authorized UI/UX-only scope. Retained as historical design artifacts; not an implementation target.
displayOrderAuthority: Order the three generated-image outputs were displayed in the main conversation, not request or completion order.
generation: Built-in ImageGen using the three public references described in prompts.json.
implementationCautions: All data, tests, code and statuses in these images are synthetic; no runtime acceptance is implied.
Question choices in an image do not establish a supported response API. Render actual permission actions or route to the native session.
The artifact viewer requires a separately implemented bounded read-only Git RPC; no public native openDiff route was confirmed.
Use the interaction specification to correct generated text, illustrative code and source-attribution details during implementation.
Workspace, attention and review are stages of one experience, not mutually exclusive product architectures. Colors are adjustable tokens.
Native shell, composer, routing and workspace tools remain host-owned; the generated full-app frame does not establish a public replacement API.
Timeline transformers do not compose arbitrarily. Core workflow must function without them; see ../compatibility-contract.md.
scopeDecision: Only presentation and interaction improvements within existing Paseo surfaces; no workspace overview, inbox, evidence center, new workflow or delegated feature dependency.
